claim_summary: For one explicit six-site rational coupled completion whose upper-left block is the F4 witness, seven unit coordinate-pair auxiliaries across a K_{4,2} graph make the four-site retained-coordinate slice even-windable. Its Delta changes from -245931/32768 to 28101/32768; an exact pair-flip witness is checked. The cross blocks change the original F4 signature, so this is not a conservative extension of F4 and does not establish full six-site windability or a sampler.
